item.title: GroceryRun Privacy Policy
item.description:
Effective date: August 3, 2026

GroceryRun keeps a running total of your estimated grocery bill while you shop so you’ll never be surprised at the register.

What GroceryRun collects

Nothing.

Not your name. Not your location. Not your shopping habits.

Not even “anonymized usage data.”

The app never connects to the internet.

There are no accounts, no analytics, no ads, and no third-party anything inside it.

What stays on your device

The running total you build while shopping lives in the app on your phone, and it goes away when you tap Clear.

item.title: GroceryRun Support
item.description:
GroceryRun keeps a running total of your groceries while you shop, so the number at the register is never a surprise.

How it works

Tap the button closest to each price as the item goes into your cart: $5, $1, 25¢, or 5¢.

An item priced at $1.49?

Tap $1, 25¢, 25¢. Done.

The goal is a close total, not an exact one. Staying within a few dollars of the register is what keeps a budget honest.
